static_traits.name: 刘文迪
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；既往without类似心理问题；not yet接受过心理治疗/咨询
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑较为连贯；Low mood并反复Self-denial；倾向与他人比较；配合度Good

basic_info.main_problem: 在输掉一盘投入大量精力准备的国际象棋对局后，出现强烈的自卑感与“我永远not会下得好”的信念，造成明显的痛苦并降低自尊。
basic_info.core_demands: 在输掉棋局后自卑与Intensifying self-doubt，这促使我寻求咨询。

special_situations.event: After investing much time and energy preparing, loses a game of chess
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我输了，即使很努力，也证明我have not能力，not yet来也not会变好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Practices twice as much, collects online techniques, tries to improve quickly to prove oneself

special_situations.event: Seeing others excel at chess or be praised
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人表现更好或被认可，就说明我很差、比not过他们
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids discussing chess games with others, lowers participation enthusiasm to avoid comparison and evaluation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们都比我强太多，我not可能赶上

special_situations.event: 练习时出现失误或have not立刻看到进步
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有not犯错并且赢棋才算有能力；一旦犯错就说明我not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Practices harder, pursuing immediate results, low tolerance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我又犯错了，这证明我根本not够好

special_situations.event: When recalling past matches, notices more failures than successes
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 赢棋才算数，其它小的进步都not重要
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly replays mistakes, ignoring small improvements and winning experiences
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 那些赢或发挥还可以的对局not重要，输棋才是真相

core_conflict.wish: Longs to confirm self-worth through competence and recognition
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败与被比较后显得without能，从而被negate、感到羞耻
defense_goal: 避免再次失败以保护自尊
通过not谈论与回避相关情绪来躲避羞耻感

object_relations.self_representation: not够好、容易失败并让人失望的自己
object_relations.object_representation: Others who are more excellent, appreciated, and represent standards and evaluation

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor emphasizes small progress or proposes success standards other than 'winning at chess'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 倾向将咨询师的肯定体验为对失败的粉饰与deny，进而Reinforcement“I am not good enough”的自责
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以自责与negate性的语气回应，反复强调“I am not good enough/这not算数”，弱化咨询师的正向反馈。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites behavioral experiments or encourages continuing to play chess and allowing mistakes
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将尝试视为再次暴露without能的风险，认为一旦失败就坐实“without能”
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Postpones or avoids trying for rational reasons (such as 'wait until I am a bit more prepared'), in a restrained and cautious tone.

manifestations: 将自我价值与“赢/输”结果强绑定；输棋后体验到“努力都是徒劳”的Meaninglessness感
Small progress and learning ignored; winning and losing become the sole measure
outcomes: Avoiding participation brings further emptiness and frustration

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Evaluating oneself by the rigid rule of 'only winning the chess game counts as success'
Takes others' praise and external evaluation as the only standard

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 频繁自我批评（“I am not good enough”）
Extremely sensitive to making mistakes, acts cautiously, avoids trying

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Turns emotions about failure and comparison into self-blame and internal friction
Lowers willingness to discuss with or seek help from others

exception_events.target_problem: 在进行与国际象棋相关的活动时，刘文迪通常会陷入“我永远not够好”的想法，negate积极表现并失去继续练习的动力。
exception_events.unique_outcome: She mentioned 'in some games I played okay, even won', at that time able to obtain some enjoyment from the game and notice improvements in strategy and concepts.
exception_events.reason: 线索：那些对局中出现了可被觉察的具体进步（策略更熟练、概念理解更清晰），由此带来not同体验与情绪强度下降。

positive_force: Willing to seek help and enter counseling
Keeps practicing and actively looks up online techniques
能识do not并口述自身思维模式
Has had experiences of winning chess or performing better for reference
negative_force: Catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and black-and-white thinking突出
negate积极结果、心理过滤明显
过度比较并依赖外部评价
Takes winning and losing as the only value condition; low fault tolerance
Reduced motivation与回避倾向，Reinforcement失败体验

target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem、Low mood、进一步降低练习与参与的动机

target_behavior.consequence: 兴趣与生活参与度下降，Reinforcementwithout力感与负性自我评价
